read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 3.2% on Nov 12 to $137.71, trading $134.05–139.56 on light volume (0.58x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($134.3) and below the 10-day ($138.6) and 30-day ($151.2); all three averages are falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 89 sessions). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($161.85), and RSI is 44.4.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月12日下跌 3.2%，收于 $137.71，盘中区间 $134.05–139.56，成交量偏低（20 日均量的 0.58 倍）。股价位于 5 日均线（$134.3）上方，10 日（$138.6）和 30 日均线（$151.2）下方；三条均线均在下行（上市仅 89 个交易日，尚无 100、200 日均线）。MACD 于 11月12日上穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$161.85），RSI 为 44.4。

read.en: The pullback gave back the 10-day and the $141.2 Nov 4 low, now resistance again, but held above the 5-day and the $133.8–135.6 band. Resistance is $138.6–141.2, then $145.8–147.7 and $151.2–151.8 (30-day, Nov 4 high). Support is $133.8–135.6, then $129.7–130.8 (Nov 10 close, Oct 22 low) and $122.2 (Nov 5 low). A close above $141.2 would target $146–148; below $133.8, $130–131.

read.en: SK hynix's latest Seoul close is ₩1,254,000, down from ₩1,277,000 in the previous read; the latest full session ranged ₩1,245,000–1,310,000. It is above the falling 5-day (₩1,226,600) and below the falling 10-day (₩1,279,500), 30-day (₩1,399,600) and 100-day (₩1,737,360) and the rising 200-day (₩1,519,600). MACD is above its signal (crossed on the latest bar), below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,489,560), and RSI is 42.0.
read.zh: SK 海力士首尔最新收盘价为 ₩1,254,000，低于上次解读的 ₩1,277,000；最近一个完整交易日区间为 ₩1,245,000–1,310,000。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（₩1,226,600）上方，下行的 10 日（₩1,279,500）、30 日（₩1,399,600）和 100 日均线（₩1,737,360）以及上行的 200 日均线（₩1,519,600）下方。MACD 位于信号线上方（最新一根 K 线上穿），在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月4日起看空（₩1,489,560），RSI 为 42.0。

read.en: The ₩1,310,000 high pushed past the 10-day intraday, but the close slipped back to ₩1,254,000, still holding the ₩1,245,000–1,250,000 band. Resistance is ₩1,279,500–1,310,000 (10-day, latest high), then ₩1,320,000 (Nov 4 high) and ₩1,373,000 (Aug 10 low). Support is ₩1,245,000–1,250,000, then ₩1,212,000–1,226,600 (Nov 9 close, 5-day) and ₩1,171,000. A close above ₩1,310,000 would target ₩1.32–1.37 million; below ₩1,245,000, ₩1.21–1.23 million.
